title: external_view ImportDialog access violation under Qt offscreen/test teardown
notes: Reproduced before and after CP1. Do not mark CP1 general regression green. Diagnosis should focus on QDialog/QScrollArea/QPushButton lifetime or parent destruction in the legacy external view path; not bundled into CP1 fixes.
next_action: Keep the regression test; do not restore class-level patching of Qt methods.
root_cause: Unit test patched PySide6 QDialog.exec on the ImportDialog class with unittest.mock; this corrupted the Qt binding and produced an access violation while constructing the next ImportDialog. The product ImportDialog path itself was not the cause.
resolution: Replaced the class-level exec patch with the real embedded import dialog and an explicit reject() to exercise the rejection path.
